title: Date Picker
description: A custom calendar date picker: single dates, disabled days, a date range and a field you can type into or pick from.

appointment.title: Appointment
appointment.instructions: Book a weekday from today onwards. Weekends and past days cannot be picked.
appointment.label: Appointment date

trip.title: Trip
trip.instructions: Pick the first and then the last day of your trip, from today onwards.
trip.label: Trip dates

birth-date.title: Date of birth
birth-date.instructions: Type the date as {{format}} and press Enter, or pick it from the calendar.
birth-date.label: Date of birth

errors.future: Date of birth cannot be in the future
errors.too-early: Date of birth cannot be before {{year}}
